meta.title: Threading Deficit and Angular Entropy in 3D Navier-Stokes
meta.subtitle: A Conditional Regularity Framework (Operational Geometry)
meta.author: Zelenka_D

citations.cite_as: Zelenka, D. (2026). Threading Deficit and Angular Entropy in 3D Navier-Stokes: A Conditional Regularity Framework, v2. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22679104

meta.relation_to_v1: This version supersedes v1 in every respect. The unconditional global regularity claim of v1 is WITHDRAWN. Eleven errors are corrected and itemized in the errata block; the most consequential is that the v1 threading deficit vanished identically. Three unconditional structural results are added, two of which are negative and constrain what any argument of this type can achieve. Readers of v1 should not rely on any statement in it.

abstract: We introduce two Fourier-space observables for the unforced 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations: the threading deficit D_j, measuring energy carried by genuinely three-dimensional triadic structure within a dyadic shell, and the angular entropy H_j, measuring how broadly shell energy is distributed across directions. The motivating observation is geometric: incompressibility confines each Fourier mode to the 2D plane orthogonal to its wavevector, so generating new directional structure requires transverse amplitude content, which carries an intrinsic volume weight. We derive a differential inequality in which viscous dissipation at rate nu*2^(2j) competes against inflow from lower shells with geometric weight 2^(k+j), giving separation 2^(j-k). We prove three unconditional results: sup_j H_j is exactly invariant under the NS scaling symmetry and therefore cannot obstruct self-similar blowup; a fixed angular partition makes any bound sup_{j,t} H_j < infinity vacuous; and entropy enters a BKM estimate only multiplicatively alongside shell enstrophy. The regularity statement is conditional with hypotheses stated explicitly; the v1 global claim is demoted to a conjecture with gaps enumerated. We locate where an external force enters the estimates, which separates this framework from the 2026 forced blowup constructions, and give four falsification protocols.

errata_v1.purpose: Full disclosure of corrections. Each item is an error in DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18214940.

E1_deficit_vanishes.v1: D_j = sum |k1.(k2 x k3)| * |u^(k1)||u^(k2)||u^(k3)| over triads k1+k2+k3=0
E1_deficit_vanishes.problem: For k1+k2+k3=0 the three wavevectors are linearly dependent, so k1.(k2 x k3) = 0 IDENTICALLY, for every triad. The v1 threading deficit was the zero function and the stated coplanar/noncoplanar dichotomy did not exist.
E1_deficit_vanishes.fix: Replace the weight by the volume spanned by two wavevectors and the velocity amplitude of the third: V = |k1.(k2 x u^(k3))|. This vanishes exactly when the amplitude lies in the wavevector plane, which is the intended geometric content and is a genuine dichotomy.

E2_dissipation_exponent.problem: D_j is LINEAR in the triple-product weight, so the weight factors out of both sides and cannot multiply the rate. v1 confused the size of D_j with the size of its logarithmic derivative. Additionally the critical_ratio field derived 2^(-5j) as 2^(-2j-3j), adding exponents where a ratio requires subtracting them, and conflicted with the separation_factor field which gave 2^(2(j-k)).
E2_dissipation_exponent.fix: Correct rate is -c*nu*2^(2j)*D_j with c in [1,3], from -nu*sum_i |k_i|^2 ~ -3nu*2^(2j).

E3_impossible_inflow_geometry.v1: inflow triads have two modes at scale 2^k and one at 2^j, weight ~ 2^(2k+j)
E3_impossible_inflow_geometry.problem: Impossible for j > k+1: k1+k2+k3=0 forces |k3| <= |k1|+|k2| ~ 2^(k+1).
E3_impossible_inflow_geometry.fix: Admissible configuration is ONE low mode and TWO high modes. Weight <= 2^(k+j)*|u^(k3)|. Separation factor is 2^(j-k), not 2^(2(j-k)) and not 2^(5j).

E4_circular_enstrophy_bound.problem: Not an a priori bound for 3D NS. Only ||u||_L2 is non-increasing. Enstrophy growth is precisely the quantity at issue, so the step assumed the conclusion.
E4_circular_enstrophy_bound.fix: All estimates now conditional on sup_{t<T} ||u(t)||_H1^2 <= K over the interval considered.

E5_vacuous_hypothesis.v1: T1 hypothesis sup_{j,t} H_j(t) <= H_max < infinity
E5_vacuous_hypothesis.problem: With a fixed partition into N caps, H_j in [0, log N] by construction. The hypothesis holds unconditionally for every solution, so T1 alone would settle the Millennium problem in two pages.
E5_vacuous_hypothesis.fix: Scale-adapted partition delta_j = 2^(-j), N_j ~ 2^(2j), ceiling H_j <= 2j*log(2).

E6_divergent_series.v1: sum_j 2^(-4j) over j in Z, evaluated as 1/(1-2^(-4))
E6_divergent_series.problem: Diverges as j -> -infinity. The geometric-series evaluation silently assumed j >= 0.
E6_divergent_series.fix: Restrict to j >= 0; handle low modes separately.

E7_internal_contradiction_L2.v1: initial_data_remarks claimed L2 robustness with H_j(epsilon) ~ log(2^(2j)/epsilon), absorbed by 2^(-4j) summability
E7_internal_contradiction_L2.problem: log(2^(2j)/epsilon) grows linearly in j, so sup_j H_j(0) = infinity, contradicting step_6 which requires it finite. Summability absorbs the INCREMENT, not the baseline.
E7_internal_contradiction_L2.fix: Contradiction resolved in favour of the refining partition, which predicts exactly this linear-in-j ceiling. L2 robustness claim deleted; u_0 in H^s, s > 5/2 carried explicitly.

E8_entropy_support_direction.v1: step_7: bounded entropy implies energy concentrated in ~ e^H angular bins, hence bounded vorticity gradients
E8_entropy_support_direction.problem: Shannon entropy bounds support size from BELOW, not above. No statement of the form 'H_j small implies few occupied bins' is available. Separately, H_j is normalization-invariant and carries no amplitude information, so it cannot control ||omega||_Linfinity.
E8_entropy_support_direction.fix: Lemma L_concentration gives the valid one-sided substitute: at least half the shell mass sits in at most e^(2H_j) bins. Residual half appears as an explicit remainder R_j.

E9_circular_corollaries.v1: Corollary 'Blowup as Computational Impossibility' and Appendix A Corollary 'Friction Prevents Blowup'
E9_circular_corollaries.problem: Both deduce bounded enstrophy from an assumption of bounded enstrophy.
E9_circular_corollaries.fix: Removed. Replaced by the explicit gap list.

E10_omega3_variational.v1: Appendix A: minimize L = sum_j 2^(2j)E_j - lambda*sum_j E_j to obtain E_j ~ Omega_3^(-j)
E10_omega3_variational.problem: L is LINEAR in the variables E_j, so on the simplex its minimum is at a vertex, placing all energy in the lowest shell. No interior critical point exists and Omega_3 does not appear.
E10_omega3_variational.fix: Demoted to conjecture. A derivation would require a functional nonlinear in the shell energies, e.g. sum_j Phi(E_j, E_{j+1}) with Phi derived from the triadic structure.

items: Fourier-space equation had +nu|k|^2 u^(k); correct sign is -nu|k|^2 u^(k).
P_k is not integral (division by |k|^2), so its reduction mod M_j was undefined. Repaired via tilde-P_k[xi] = |k|^2*xi - k(k.xi).
Omega_3 (root of x^3 = x^2+1, ~1.46557) was called the plastic ratio; the plastic ratio is the root of x^3 = x+1, ~1.32472. Omega_3 is the supergolden ratio.
Text cited 'Constantin-Fefferman-Majda' for a Constantin-Fefferman paper; year given as 1996, correct year 1993.
gamma_j was defined via 'n ~ j', an undefined relation between problem size and dyadic scale.

partition.name: scale_adapted_angular_partition
partition.definition: caps Gamma_alpha^(j) on S^2 of angular diameter delta_j
partition.rationale: finest partition separating distinct lattice directions within S_j; a FIXED partition makes the entropy hypothesis vacuous (see E5)

V.name: threading_volume_weight
V.vanishes_when: u^(k3) lies in the plane of k1,k2 (no transverse 3D content)
V.replaces: v1 weight |k1.(k2 x k3)|, which vanished identically (see E1)

A_j.name: coupled_observable
A_j.role: NOT scaling-invariant; proposed replacement for H_j as the controlling variable

R_j.name: low_occupancy_remainder
R_j.definition: contribution of angular bins carrying less than exp(-2H_j) of shell mass

P_scaling.name: Scaling_Invariance_of_Angular_Entropy
P_scaling.statement: For u_lambda(x,t) = lambda*u(lambda*x, lambda^2*t): H_j(u_lambda) = H_(j - log2 lambda)(u), hence sup_j H_j(u_lambda) = sup_j H_j(u).
P_scaling.proof: u^_lambda(k) = lambda^(-2) u^(k/lambda). The map k -> k/lambda carries S_j onto S_(j-log2 lambda) and fixes directions, hence carries the cap family at scale j onto that at scale j-log2 lambda. The prefactor is constant on each shell and cancels in the ratios p_j,alpha. Suprema over j remove the shift.
P_scaling.consequence: No bound on sup_j H_j alone can exclude a self-similar singularity. This is the precise reason v1's T1 could not have been true as stated.
P_scaling.repair_indicated: any working criterion must BREAK the scaling; the factor 2^(2j)E_j does so

P_vacuity.name: Vacuity_Under_Fixed_Partition
P_vacuity.statement: If S^2 is partitioned into a fixed N caps independent of j, then 0 <= H_j <= log N for every solution, j and t.
P_vacuity.proof: Shannon entropy of a probability vector of length N lies in [0, log N].
P_vacuity.consequence: v1's T1 hypothesis is satisfied unconditionally and carries no information.

L_inflow_geometry.name: Inflow_Triad_Geometry
L_inflow_geometry.statement: If k1+k2+k3=0 with |k3| ~ 2^j and |k1| ~ 2^k, k < j-1, then |k2| ~ 2^j. Hence 'two low, one high' is impossible for j > k+1, and the admissible weight satisfies V <= 2^k * 2^j * |u^(k3)|.
L_inflow_geometry.proof: k2 = -(k1+k3) with |k1| << |k3| gives |k2| in [|k3|-|k1|, |k3|+|k1|]. The v1 configuration would need |k3| <= |k1|+|k2| ~ 2^(k+1), contradicting |k3| ~ 2^j.

L_concentration.name: Entropy_Concentration
L_concentration.statement: For a probability vector with entropy H, set theta = exp(-2H) and B = {alpha: p_alpha < theta}. Then sum_{B} p_alpha <= 1/2 and #{alpha not in B} <= exp(2H).
L_concentration.proof: For alpha in B, log(1/p_alpha) > 2H, so H >= sum_B p_alpha log(1/p_alpha) > 2H * sum_B p_alpha, giving sum_B p_alpha < 1/2. Each alpha outside B has p_alpha >= theta and total mass is 1, so there are at most 1/theta = exp(2H) of them.
L_concentration.reading: At least HALF the mass sits in at most exp(2H) bins. This is the correct one-sided substitute for v1's claim; entropy bounds support size only from below.

P_bkm.name: Entropy_Enstrophy_Vorticity_Estimate
P_bkm.proof: Split caps into the high-occupancy set G with #G <= exp(2H_j) (L_concentration) and its complement. On G, each cap meets O(2^j) lattice points of S_j, so Cauchy-Schwarz gives (#G * O(2^j))^(1/2) * (sum_{S_j} |k|^2|u^(k)|^2)^(1/2).
P_bkm.significance: Entropy appears ONLY multiplicatively alongside shell enstrophy 2^(2j)E_j. This identifies A_j as the correct object and explains why H_j alone was never sufficient.

L_threading_subspace.name: Incompressibility_Threading_Constraint
L_threading_subspace.statement: div(u) = 0 => u^(k) in V_k^perp for all k
L_threading_subspace.note: retained unchanged from v1; the only v1 lemma that was correct as stated

T_deficit.name: Deficit_Inequality
T_deficit.logarithmic_loss: a factor j^(1/2) from Cauchy-Schwarz in k was absorbed crudely; see G7

C_deficit_equilibrium.name: Deficit_Equilibrium
C_deficit_equilibrium.key_point: The inhomogeneous term has NO decay in j. The deficit does not decay to zero; it relaxes to an inflow-supported equilibrium.

P_coupling.name: Entropy_Growth_Requires_Deficit
unresolved: logarithmic weights log(p_j,alpha) are unbounded as p -> 0; the required cutoff is not accounted for
inter-cap transfer is asserted PROPORTIONAL to V, not merely bounded by a quantity involving V

T_entropy.name: Entropy_Growth_Bound
T_entropy.v1_claimed: H_j(t) <= H_j(0) + C/(nu * 2^(4j)), uniform in t
T_entropy.why_weaker: grows linearly in t and decays only as 2^(-j); the uniform-in-time statement does not follow because C_deficit_equilibrium has a non-decaying inhomogeneous term
T_entropy.caveat: conclusion is weaker than it appears: the ceiling H_j <= 2j*log(2) means what is needed is control of H_j RELATIVE to its ceiling as t -> T^-, which this does not provide

T_continuation.name: Conditional_Continuation
T_continuation.hypothesis: u_0 in H^s, s > 5/2, and integral_0^T sum_(j>=0) [ (2^j*exp(2H_j))^(1/2)*(2^(2j)E_j)^(1/2) + R_j ] dt < infinity
T_continuation.proof_method: P_bkm bounds integral ||omega||_Linfinity dt; apply BKM_1984
T_continuation.replaces: v1 T1, whose proof was invalid (E8)
T_continuation.note: a genuine criterion, but NOT implied by any bound on H_j alone, consistent with P_scaling

ND.name: Non_Degeneracy_Hypothesis
ND.statement: exists eta > 0 with E_j(t) >= eta * 2^(-2j) * sup_{t'<T} ||u(t')||_H1^2 for all j >= 0, t < T with E_j(t) > 0
ND.status: UNJUSTIFIED; restrictive; no reason to expect it uniformly in j (see G3)

CONJ_global.name: Global_Regularity_Unforced
CONJ_global.statement: Smooth, finite-energy, divergence-free initial data with no external force generate solutions that remain smooth for all t >= 0.
CONJ_global.note: This is the Clay problem (statements A, B). v1 asserted it as a corollary; that assertion is withdrawn.

CONJ_coupled.name: Coupled_Observable_Criterion
CONJ_coupled.statement: If integral_0^T sum_(j>=0) A_j(t)^(1/2) dt < infinity then the solution extends past T; moreover the threading mechanism controls A_j for the unforced equations.
CONJ_coupled.first_half: close to a corollary of P_bkm and BKM_1984, modulo R_j
CONJ_coupled.second_half: the substantive open claim of this framework

CONJ_omega3.name: Omega_3_Spectral_Signature
CONJ_omega3.statement: In statistically stationary 3D incompressible turbulence, E_j/E_(j+1) approaches a constant determined by Omega_3 ~ 1.46557.
CONJ_omega3.status: OPEN, logically independent of the main results
CONJ_omega3.confound: Kolmogorov scaling E(kappa) ~ kappa^(-5/3) integrates over a dyadic shell to E_j ~ 2^(-2j/3), giving E_j/E_(j+1) = 2^(2/3) ~ 1.5874, within 8% of Omega_3. Any test MUST separate these to be informative. We expect the Kolmogorov value.
CONJ_omega3.honest_note: this near-coincidence is the most likely explanation of the conjecture's appeal

identified_gaps.ordering: decreasing severity; stated as well-posed problems, not obstacles

G1_coupling.problem: Establish or refute dH_j/dt <~ nu^(-1) D_j/(2^j E_j) with the logarithmic weights handled rigorously.
G1_coupling.consequence_if_false: the chain has no first link

G2_supercriticality.problem: Tao's averaged 3D NS equation satisfies every function-space upper bound on the nonlinearity that the true equation satisfies, plus the energy identity, and admits finite-time blowup. Determine whether the T_deficit estimates are available to the averaged nonlinearity.
G2_supercriticality.expectation: They are NOT, because averaging destroys the correlation between wavevector geometry and amplitude direction on which V depends, whereas function-space bounds are insensitive to that correlation.
G2_supercriticality.if_expectation_correct: this is the precise sense in which the approach evades the barrier, and should be stated as a theorem about the mechanism
G2_supercriticality.if_expectation_wrong: the approach cannot work and the framework should be abandoned in its present form
G2_supercriticality.note: single most informative test in the document; Protocol 2

G3_degeneracy.problem: ND is used to divide by E_j and is not justified. In a concentrating solution high shells carry a small fraction of enstrophy at their own scale, exactly where H_j becomes ill-conditioned.
options: replace H_j by an unnormalized functional
establish ND on a bootstrap interval

G4_time_uniformity.problem: T_entropy grows linearly in t. A uniform bound needs either time decay in the inflow-supported equilibrium, or a mechanism converting integral ||grad u||_L2^2 dt < infinity into shellwise decay.
G4_time_uniformity.v1_status: asserted in a single unproved sentence

G5_circularity.problem: T_deficit assumes ||u||_H1^2 <= K. Closing requires a bootstrap in which the conclusion improves K. Not carried out.
G5_circularity.consequence: the results are conditional regularity CRITERIA, not a regularity proof

G6_remainder.problem: L_concentration controls half the shell energy. Bound R_j, or iterate the concentration argument dyadically in theta to capture the remainder at logarithmic cost.

G7_log_losses.problem: The j^(1/2) factor in T_deficit was absorbed crudely. Track it; at critical scaling logarithmic factors can decide the outcome.

forced_unforced_boundary.purpose: Separate this framework from the 2026 forced blowup constructions so the two are not mistaken for competing answers to one question.

context_2026.alpoge_buckmaster: finite-time blowup with smooth forcing for incompressible porous medium, Boussinesq and Euler equations (Sept 2026), building on Cordoba and Martinez-Zoroa
context_2026.openai: proof of finite-time blowup for FORCED 3D Navier-Stokes with Lean formalization (Sept 2026): fluid initially at rest, smooth force compactly supported in space and time, velocity unbounded in finite time, kinetic energy bounded throughout
context_2026.clay_mapping: establishes statements C and D; statements A and B (unforced) remain open
context_2026.palasek: identified an obstruction to producing an unforced blowup by the same widely-separated-frequency mechanism (verify citation before submission)

closed_unforced.enstrophy_accounting: ||u||_H1 constrained by the energy inequality; bootstrap conceivable
closed_unforced.noncoplanar_content: must be generated internally, priced by D_j

open_forced.equations: smooth f, compactly supported in space and time
open_forced.noncoplanar_content: can be deposited directly by f

forced_unforced_boundary.where_forcing_enters: Exactly one place: the hypothesis ||u||_H1^2 <= K of T_deficit. Without forcing this is a hypothesis one may hope to close by bootstrap, supported by the energy inequality. With forcing the energy inequality acquires a source term and K is no longer controlled by the initial data at all. A force may be designed to deposit enstrophy, and specifically TRANSVERSE amplitude direction, at prescribed scales and times. Since D_j measures exactly that transverse content, forcing supplies directly the quantity whose internal generation the deficit inequality prices.
forced_unforced_boundary.boundary_statement: The threading obstruction, if valid, binds exactly when the fluid must generate its own noncoplanar angular refinement from its own resources. An external force lifts it by supplying that geometry from outside the energy accounting.
forced_unforced_boundary.relation_to_IOT_boundary_note: Same type of boundary condition as the one separating the two regimes in the P=NP companion note (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18566802): a superlinear or exponential cost is never eliminated, only relocated across resource dimensions. Here the geometric coordination cost of angular refinement is relocated from the fluid's own nonlinearity into the forcing term.
what_this_does_NOT_license: It does not follow that the unforced problem is regular. Palasek's obstruction concerns one mechanism; other routes to an unforced construction are not excluded.

It does not follow that the 2026 result is physically empty. A finite-time singularity in a continuum model marks the scale at which the model must be replaced, which is informative; shocks in compressible Euler are genuine mathematical singularities signalling a real thin dissipative layer. For incompressible NS that scale lies below the molecular mean free path, so no accessible new physics is indicated. This is why the regularity problem is generally regarded as mathematically rather than physically consequential, and it is not an argument for either answer.
It does not rescue v1's claim that blowup is 'operationally impossible'. That was a statement about finite ENERGY, and the 2026 construction keeps energy finite. WITHDRAWN without qualification.

operational_geometry_framework.status: INTERPRETATION, not derivation. Marked as such throughout.
operational_geometry_framework.generative_role: This reading is what produced the observables D_j and V. That generative role is taken seriously; it is nonetheless not a substitute for the estimates.

IOGT.name: Intrinsic_Operational_Gradient_Theorem
IOGT.connection_to_NS: D_j proposed as a measure of gradient steepness
IOGT.missing: Exhibiting the fluid as a composable operational system with the non-invertibility hypothesis verified. G2 is the concrete form this requirement takes.

IOT.name: Irreducible_Overhead_Theorem
IOT.v1_claim: blowup is computationally forbidden because finite energy cannot sustain infinite enstrophy
IOT.status: WITHDRAWN (see E9 and the 2026 constructions, which keep energy finite)
IOT.bridge_problem: The IOT concerns decision problems and computational resources. Applying it to a PDE requires a functor from triadic interaction structure to a model of computation under which triadic interactions map to elementary operations, angular bins to distinguishable configurations, and enstrophy to a resource measure satisfying the theorem's accounting hypotheses. No such functor is constructed.
IOT.what_survives: A suggestive scaling only: exponential in Delta against polynomial in 2^j, the same shape as the deficit-versus-dissipation competition, possibly its operational shadow.

threading_aggregate_view.fluid_interpretation: stable pattern threading coherently across scales
threading_aggregate_view.incompressibility_role: supplies a QUANTIFIABLE SHARE of the constraint maintaining coherence
threading_aggregate_view.v1_wording: 'provides sufficient threading constraint to prevent breakdown' - sufficiency not established

operational_geometry_framework.research_thesis: The regularity or breakdown of a continuum field theory may be determined by the geometric cost of maintaining coherent structure across scales, and that cost may be computable from the constraint structure of the equations rather than from their analytic form. In the incompressible NS case the constraint is div(u)=0, the cost is measured by D_j, and the competition against viscosity is the content of T_deficit. Not established.

critical_inequalities.dissipation: c*nu*2^(2j) at shell j, c in [1,3]
critical_inequalities.summability: sum_(j>=0) 2^(-j) < infinity at fixed t; NOT uniform in t

initial_data_remarks.regularity_required: u_0 in H^s with s > 5/2, carried explicitly into every statement

L2_initial_data.reason: H_j(epsilon) ~ log(2^(2j)/epsilon) grows linearly in j, so sup_j H_j(0) = infinity; summability absorbs the increment, not the baseline (E7)
L2_initial_data.silver_lining: this linear-in-j growth is exactly what the refining partition predicts as the ceiling, so the two are now consistent

initial_data_remarks.low_modes: sums restricted to j >= 0; low modes handled separately (E6)

P1_evaluate_on_published_blowup.input: the constructed forced solutions of the 2026 manuscripts, truncated after n stages of the iterative construction, evaluated as t -> T^-
P1_evaluate_on_published_blowup.decision_rule: If sup_j H_j remains bounded as t -> T^- while the solution becomes singular, then bounded angular entropy is COMPATIBLE with blowup and no criterion phrased in H_j alone can work. Report this.
P1_evaluate_on_published_blowup.expectation: P_scaling predicts bounded H_j if the mechanism is approximately self-similar. A bounded result CONFIRMS the negative structural results rather than refuting the framework, and directs attention to A_j.
P1_evaluate_on_published_blowup.key_discriminator: if A_j diverges while H_j does not, that is direct evidence A_j is the correct object

P2_averaged_equation_test.compute: whether the V-weighted projection estimate survives replacement of P_k by the averaged multiplier
P2_averaged_equation_test.decision_rule: If the estimates transfer, they cannot imply global regularity and the approach is closed; report and stop. If not, identify the exact failing step: that step is the structural input by which the approach evades the barrier, and should be isolated and stated as a theorem.

P3_dns_deficit_tracking.input: pseudospectral DNS, 512^3 or above, Taylor-Green and Kida-Pelz initial data plus a decaying-turbulence run
compute: E_j, E_j,alpha, H_j on the delta_j = 2^(-j) partition
D_j by importance sampling over triads with weights proportional to |u^(k1)||u^(k2)|, >= 10^6 samples per shell, sampling error reported (exact evaluation is O(N^6) and infeasible)
both sides of T_deficit separately: measured dD_j/dt by finite difference, modelled dissipation, modelled inflow
P3_dns_deficit_tracking.decision_rule: T_deficit fails if measured dD_j/dt exceeds the modelled right-hand side for any absolute c, C consistent across shells and times. Fit c, C on one run and test on another.
P3_dns_deficit_tracking.secondary: distinguish decay-to-zero (v1 prediction) from relaxation to the inflow-supported equilibrium D_j ~ nu^(-1) K^(1/2) E_j (v2 prediction). These are distinguishable.
P3_dns_deficit_tracking.also_verify: the predicted 2^(j-k) separation between intra-shell and inflow geometric weights

P4_omega3_spectral.input: any high-Reynolds-number DNS or experimental spectrum with a resolved inertial range
P4_omega3_spectral.compute: shell ratio E_j/E_(j+1) across the inertial range
P4_omega3_spectral.decision_rule: Informative ONLY if it separates Omega_3 ~ 1.4656 from 2^(2/3) ~ 1.5874, requiring the ratio to better than ~4% with the inertial range identified independently of the fit. Reported agreement with Omega_3 that does not exclude 2^(2/3) establishes nothing.
P4_omega3_spectral.note: tests CONJ_omega3 only; failure does not affect the main results

physical_interpretation.one_line: Incompressibility prices the creation of transverse three-dimensional structure; whether that price exceeds the fluid's internal budget is open.
physical_interpretation.short_form: Incompressibility locks each mode into a 2D plane. Creating new directional structure requires amplitude transverse to the wavevector plane, weighted by V. Viscosity drains this at rate nu*2^(2j) while lower shells supply it with weight 2^(k+j), a separation of 2^(j-k). Whether the drain wins is CONDITIONAL on an enstrophy bound not yet established. An external force pays the price from outside and lifts the obstruction entirely.
physical_interpretation.v1_short_form_withdrawn: 'These have maximum penalty and decay exponentially fast. Angular complexity cannot grow. No blowup.' - each clause fails: the v1 weight vanished identically, the deficit relaxes to a nonzero equilibrium rather than decaying, and angular complexity is bounded by 2j*log(2) for trivial reasons that carry no regularity information.

full_recovery: 1. Define dyadic shells S_j = {k: 2^j <= |k| < 2^(j+1)}, restrict to j >= 0.
2. Partition S^2 into caps of diameter delta_j = 2^(-j), N_j ~ 2^(2j). Do NOT use a fixed partition (E5).
3. Compute E_j,alpha, E_j, p_j,alpha and H_j. Note H_j <= 2j*log(2) and that H_j is normalization-invariant.
4. Prove P_vacuity and P_scaling FIRST; they determine what any subsequent argument can achieve.
5. Define V(k1,k2;u^) = |k1.(k2 x u^(k3))| and D_j as the V-weighted triad sum. Verify V does not vanish identically (E1).
6. Write Fourier-space NS with the correct sign: d_t u^(k) = -nu|k|^2 u^(k) - i P_k[convolution].
7. Differentiate D_j. Extract dissipation -c*nu*2^(2j)*D_j; note the weight factors out and does NOT multiply the rate (E2).
8. Classify inflow triads via L_inflow_geometry (one low, two high). Bound the weight by 2^(k+j) (E3).
9. State the enstrophy hypothesis K explicitly; do not assume ||u||_H1 <= ||u_0||_H1 (E4).
10. Gronwall to C_deficit_equilibrium. Note the non-decaying inhomogeneous term.
11. Attempt G1 (entropy-deficit coupling) rigorously, with the log-weight cutoff accounted for.
12. Prove L_concentration and P_bkm. Do NOT claim entropy bounds support size from above (E8).
13. State T_continuation in terms of the coupled observable, not H_j alone.
14. Run Protocols 1 and 2 before extending anything.
